added_failures_note: the reviewed manifest left baseline_suite empty; the count was taken from its own baseline arm baseline-queue.log

findings.text: follow-on: the dedup predicate matches on phase, session, node id and node.plan but omits node.section, so two held dispatches of one node id in different sections of a plan from one session collide and the second silently replaces the first's section and request.

follow-on: queue_dispatch writes the live pointer through _write_json while holding locks/queued-dispatch.lock instead of the per-run lock _mutate_pointer uses at reckon/crew/runs.py:550-573, so a queued pointer's write and a concurrent per-run mutation of the same file take different locks and are not mutually exclusive.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit cf71f7ee against base 07620d34, +274/-7 across runs.py, dispatch.py, recovery.py, crew_dispatch_commands.py and the new test file.

item_verdicts.goal: plan §2's goal is that a held local dispatch becomes one durable queued live pointer carrying its full request, hold reason and join time with no worktree; reckon/crew/runs.py:577 queue_dispatch writes exactly that record and reckon/crew/dispatch.py:935 raises LaneHeld carrying its run id and position.

justifications.durability: the manifest's negative control removes the queued-pointer write and tests/test_held_dispatch_is_queued.py:78 and :170 redden (EXIT=1), so the queued cases name a condition under which they fail.
justifications.evidence: the committed-head gate is recorded (gate-committed.log 56 passed EXIT=0) and the queued-pointer control is red (negative-control.log EXIT=1), but the reviewed manifest leaves baseline_suite empty so the store's added-failure derivation reads the base arm as absent.
justifications.fit: queue_dispatch, the queued phase and the reason field follow the live-pointer idiom in reckon/crew/runs.py around _mutate_pointer, with mechanism names and no plan labels.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/runs.py:577 queue_dispatch stores one queued pointer per project/session/node with the full request, hold and queued_at, and reckon/crew/dispatch.py:913 creates no worktree before raising, matching §2.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/runs.py:579 queue_dispatch writes the pointer under its own locks/queued-dispatch.lock via _write_json rather than the pointer-write owner _mutate_pointer/_pointer_lock at reckon/crew/runs.py:550 writes through, so two writers of one pointer do not exclude each other.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path commit cf71f7ee touches (runs.py, dispatch.py, recovery.py, crew_dispatch_commands.py, tests/test_held_dispatch_is_queued.py) is inside the manifest's declared write paths.
